observations: Three photos show a white and grey wall-mounted hair dryer with a coiled cord.
The brand 'MMAAT' is visible in blue text on the front of the device in all photos.
The text 'BATHROOMS' is printed below 'MMAAT' in all photos.
The device is mounted on a textured white wall with visible stains and discoloration.
The cord is white and coiled, with a black connector at the end.
No power plug is visible in any photo.
No model number or serial number is visible on the device or in any photo.
The device appears to be in used condition with some surface wear and discoloration on the wall.

claims.evidence: The brand 'MMAAT' is visible in all photos, but 'quality' is subjective and not verifiable from photos alone.

risks.risk: The device may not be functional or may have internal damage.
risks.proof: A video showing the device turning on and blowing air, or a photo of the power plug and cord with the device plugged in.

risks.risk: The cord may be frayed or damaged, posing a safety hazard.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the entire cord, especially near the plug and where it connects to the device.

risks.risk: The wall mounting bracket may be loose or damaged, affecting stability.
risks.proof: A photo showing the mounting bracket attached to the wall and the device in place.

proof_requests: Close-up of the rating plate on the iron or stand showing the model and pin code.
Video of the hair dryer in operation.
Close-up photo of the power plug and cord.
Photo of the mounting bracket and wall attachment.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
